newsitem.title: USA: Culligan Water closes Ametek deal.
newsitem.headline: Culligan Water closes Ametek deal.

text.p: Culligan Water Technologies Inc said Friday it has completed acquisition of the water filtration business of Ametek Inc in a stock transaction.
As a result, Ametek's water filtration business will become a wholly owned subsidiary of Culligan, and Ametek's stockholders will receive a total of 3,466,667 shares of Culligan common stock.
Ametek's water filtration business makes and markets water filtration and treatment products under the Ametek, Plymouth, American Plumber and other brand names.
Culligan makes and distributes water purification and treatment products for retail, household, bottled water, commercial and industrial applications.
